src.title: How to keep your stir-fry chicken tender and juicy 😋

recipes.title: Tender Velveted Chicken Stir Fry (homestyle)

items.i: red bell pepper, cut into strips

steps: Tenderize the chicken thighs by scoring or pounding them to break up the fibers, then cut into bite-size strips.
Add the 100 ml water and massage until the chicken absorbs it.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, white pepper and half an egg white and massage again.
Mix in the cornflour, then drizzle a little oil on top to seal it.
Heat oil in a wok and fry the chicken until golden and crisp.
Add the onion, celery and red pepper and toss over high heat, then season with oyster sauce and soy sauce (or any stir-fry sauce you like).
recipes.notes: Marinade amounts are the creator's (for 2 thighs). The vegetables and sauce are estimated from the video; he says to season it any style you like. Macros are estimated.
